contract_rule: Each stage contract names the inputs it may read and the output field family it owns; later stages may compress those outputs, but they do not silently overwrite ownership of tokens, numbers, or sentences.
downstream_rule: Cite the spine when a paper only needs the stable maintenance order; cite the owning stage contract or the narrower maintenance object whenever a numeric delta, token, or sentence is actually asserted.
note: Derived release-evolution spine for one concrete successor comparison. It states the stable maintenance stages and their tiny handoff contracts without replacing the concrete dependency DAG or the narrower verdict objects.
resolution_rule: Move strictly left-to-right: later stages may compress earlier results for readability, but they never replace the narrower maintenance objects they cite.

stage_contracts.assertion_scope: Owns the compact diff slice and classification context for the concrete base->successor comparison.
stage_contracts.handoff_rule: Later notes may summarize this stage for status prose, but numeric deltas, changed-family slices, and required-publication-role context should still cite the compare report directly.

stage_contracts.assertion_scope: Owns the continuity decision and replay scope implied by the diff under the declared action matrix.
stage_contracts.handoff_rule: Later notes may compress this stage into a status sentence, but continuity tokens and replay-scope slices still belong to the continuity verdict.

stage_contracts.assertion_scope: Owns which publication roles are required for each action class.
stage_contracts.handoff_rule: When a note asserts which outputs must be republished, cite the obligation profile (and action matrix companion) rather than a later wrapper object.

stage_contracts.assertion_scope: Owns whether the concrete successor package actually ships the outputs the obligation class requires, with row-level satisfaction carried by the companion closure ledger.
stage_contracts.handoff_rule: Later notes may summarize package completeness, but role rows belong to the closure ledger and closure tokens and bound publication outputs still belong to the closure verdict.

stage_contracts.assertion_scope: Owns the outward-facing successor-status sentence and reader-pointer order; the companion status envelope owns the narrow public-status token.
stage_contracts.handoff_rule: Cite this stage when one public sentence is enough; cite the status envelope or continue leftward to support, quote, or the narrower verdict objects when the narrow status token matters.

stage_contracts.assertion_scope: Owns clause-to-evidence bindings for outward-facing successor claims.
stage_contracts.handoff_rule: Use this stage when a referee needs clause-by-clause traceability rather than only the wrapper sentence.

stage_contracts.assertion_scope: Owns the smallest-sufficient citation choice for recurring downstream use cases; the companion branch map owns the piece-specific escalation walk once one route/piece pair is actually challenged.
stage_contracts.handoff_rule: Use this stage when the problem is citation minimization; consult the companion branch map once a concrete piece-specific escalation trace is required.

stage_contracts.assertion_scope: Owns exact-field selection once the correct citation target is known.
stage_contracts.handoff_rule: When a later note asserts a token or numeric value verbatim, it should cite the quote target or continue leftward to the owning narrow field.

stage_contracts.assertion_scope: Owns short reusable downstream wording, but only for already-checked claims.
stage_contracts.handoff_rule: Clause text may compress presentation, but any challenge must still resolve leftward through quote/support to the narrower maintenance objects.

stage_cut_rule: Stop at the earliest sufficient release-local stage for the question actually being asked, and widen rightward only when the question changes family rather than merely because later wrapper objects exist.

stage_order.question: What changed?
stage_order.stop_when: The task is identifying which field families changed and which compact classification bucket won for the concrete base->successor pair.
stage_order.why: This is the earliest sufficient cut for drift identification; later wrappers may summarize it but do not re-own the numeric or family-level delta.
stage_order.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes what replay scope, continuity class, or publication duty follows from that diff.

stage_order.question: Which replay scope and continuity class follow from the diff?
stage_order.stop_when: The task is deciding replay scope, continuity status, or whether the certified interface survived the observed drift.
stage_order.why: Continuity tokens and replay-plan scope belong here, not in the later closure or wrapper stages that cite them.
stage_order.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes which public outputs must now be refreshed or whether the shipped successor package actually closed.

stage_order.question: Which public outputs must now be refreshed?
stage_order.stop_when: The task is naming the minimal publication roles required by the winning action class.
stage_order.why: This is the earliest sufficient publication-duty cut; closure and lineage objects depend on these duties but do not define them.
stage_order.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes whether those roles were actually satisfied by the shipped successor package.

stage_order.question: Were the required successor outputs actually shipped?
stage_order.stop_when: The task is package completeness: whether the required role rows were satisfied and the successor package is closed for release purposes.
stage_order.why: This is the last release-validity cut before public wording; later wrapper stages may compress completeness but do not replace the role rows or closure token.
stage_order.widen_only_if: Widen only if the question becomes outward-facing status wording, clause support, or downstream reuse rather than package completeness itself.

stage_order.question: What is the outward-facing successor status sentence?
stage_order.stop_when: One outward-facing successor-status sentence and pointer order are enough for the downstream task.
stage_order.why: This stage owns the public wrapper sentence, but not the narrower continuity, closure, or diff fields it compresses.
stage_order.widen_only_if: Widen only if the task becomes clause-by-clause support, citation minimization, exact-field quotation, or reusable checked wording.

stage_order.question: Which narrower object supports each public clause?
stage_order.stop_when: The task is clause-level traceability for the outward-facing successor wording.
stage_order.why: This is the first sufficient cut for clause-to-evidence bindings once the wrapper sentence alone is no longer enough.
stage_order.widen_only_if: Widen only if the task becomes choosing the smallest sufficient citation target, exact quoted fields, or reusable clause text.

stage_order.question: What is the smallest sufficient downstream citation target?
stage_order.stop_when: The task is citation minimization for a recurring downstream use rather than field quotation or sentence reuse.
stage_order.why: The citation map chooses the target family; it does not yet select exact fields inside that target.
stage_order.widen_only_if: Widen only if the task becomes exact-field selection or reuse of already-checked clause text.

stage_order.question: Which exact field should later notes quote?
stage_order.stop_when: The task is quoting one exact token, number, or field after the citation target is already known.
stage_order.why: Exact-field selection is the last narrow cut before clause-level compression.
stage_order.widen_only_if: Widen only if the task becomes reusing a checked short clause instead of quoting the narrow field directly.

stage_order.question: Which short reusable clause is already checked?
stage_order.stop_when: The task is reusing one already-checked short clause rather than re-deriving wording from the narrower fields.
stage_order.why: This is the final presentation layer; it is convenient for terse papers but never re-owns the checked maintenance facts beneath it.
stage_order.widen_only_if: Do not widen rightward: any challenge should resolve leftward through quote/support to the narrower owners.

status_chain.status_summary: Successor remains on the same certified interface after replaying the changed fallback surfaces; required successor publication outputs are complete.
